posts.text: Join us at the Stadium Store on Thursday 30 July, as we celebrate the exclusive reveal of our 2026/27 @pumafootball away kit, ahead of its global launch on Friday 31 July 🩵

We've teamed up with local illustrators from Manchester, Hong Kong and Seoul to create a series of exclusive posters for our Asia pre-season tour! ✈️🌍

First up: Florence Burns from Manchester 🩵
